Question: A plane mirror is placed on the ground. Xiaoming's eyes are \(1.5\text{ m}\) above the ground. Standing \(3\text{ m}\) from the mirror, he can just see the top of a tree in it. The distance from the mirror to the base of the tree is \(12\text{ m}\) (the person, mirror, and base of the tree lie on the same straight line). Find the height of the tree. (Unit: m)
Solution: By the reflection of light, the person and the tree form two similar right triangles: \(1.5/3=h/12\), giving \(h=6\).

Original.explanation: 由光的反射，人与树构成两个相似直角三角形：1.5/3=h/12，h=6。
